result.description:
Tony's TLC Painting is a locally owned and operated painting business servicing South East Queensland, including Brisbane, the Gold Coast and Toowoomba. We provide high-quality residential, commercial, industrial and body corporate painting services and are committed to reliability, customer satisfaction, strong workmanship and attention to detail.

We are seeking an experienced Painter to join our team and support the delivery of professional painting projects across residential and commercial sites.

About the role
The successful applicant will perform painting and decorating duties, including preparing surfaces, applying paints and finishes, protecting work areas, maintaining equipment and completing work to a high professional standard.

Key duties and responsibilities
Your duties will include:
•	Erecting ladders and mobile scaffolding, and placing drop sheets and protective coverings to protect adjacent surfaces from paint splatter and damage
•	Preparing surfaces by removing old paint, loose coatings and wallpaper, repairing minor defects, filling holes and cracks, sanding, smoothing and sealing surfaces prior to painting
•	Selecting, preparing and mixing paints, stains, varnishes and other finishes to required colours, textures and specifications
•	Applying paints, varnishes, stains, sealers and other protective/decorative finishes using brushes, rollers and spray equipment
•	Painting and finishing internal and external surfaces on residential, commercial, industrial and body corporate projects
•	Hanging wallpaper or wall coverings where required, including matching patterns and trimming edges
•	Cleaning painting tools, spray equipment, work areas and project sites at completion of works
•	Identifying surface defects and advising supervisors of preparation or repair requirements before application of finishes
•	Carrying out minor repairs associated with painting preparation, including patching, sealing and basic woodwork preparation where required
•	Reading job instructions, colour schedules, work orders and product specifications to complete work to client and project requirements
•	Working safely in accordance with WHS procedures, including safe handling of paints, solvents, ladders, scaffolding and site equipment
•	Maintaining a high standard of workmanship, presentation and customer service in line with Chromatic Applications’ commitment to quality and reliability

Skills and experience required
To be considered for this role, applicants should have:
•	Relevant trade qualification desirable, but not essential
•	At least 3 years’ experience as a Painter
•	Experience in residential and/or commercial painting projects
•	Ability to prepare surfaces and apply paint systems to a professional standard
•	Experience using brushes, rollers and spray-painting equipment
•	Ability to work safely from ladders and mobile scaffolding
•	Strong attention to detail and pride in workmanship
•	Ability to follow instructions, work independently and contribute as part of a team
•	Current driver licence and reliable transport preferred
•	Construction White Card preferred or required, depending on project sites

Location: South East Queensland — Brisbane, Gold Coast, Toowoomba and surrounding project sites
Employment type: Full-time
Hours: 38 hours per week
Salary:$50-$55/hr  + superannuation

Senior Dairy Cattle Stockperson 
Location: Multiple farm sites in VIC (Girgarre East 3616, Girgarre 3624, Tongala 3621, Jancourt East 3266, Cooriemungle 3268, Port Campbell 3269)
Multiple farm sites in WA (Lake Jasper 6260, Scott River East 6275)
Tenure: Full-time, permanent
Salary: From $71,481 per year (plus superannuation)
 
Required skills and experience:
•	AQF Certificate III in Agriculture / Dairy Production (or higher equivalent)
•	Three (3) years of recent and relevant work experience

On behalf of our client, Global Skilled Employment we are looking for skilled candidates for Senior Dairy Cattle Stockperson that will join the production team of a dairy in Cranbourne, VIC 3977. 

Duties and Responsibilities:
•	Plan all aspects of milk production process including management and coordination of milking shed routines.
•	Coordinate and implement reproductive programs, including artificial insemination and herd fertility management, detection of estrous and pregnancy.
•	Assist in controlled breeding experiments to develop improved livestock strains.
•	Implement calving procedures, including the ability to physically conduct unsupervised internal assessments to minimize the incidence of still births or injuries to cow or calf.
•	Plan and manage pastures and crops for livestock production and develop livestock feeding plans.
•	Analyse produce to set and maintain standards of quality;
•	Supervise animal health programs, handle sick or injured animals and maintain an optimal environment for the wellbeing of livestock consistent with the Australian Animal Welfare Standards and Guidelines – Cattle.
•	Supervise work routines and staff performance of less experienced employees such as an assistant farmhand.
•	Implement and monitor quality assurance procedures, ensuring compliance and that all relevant documentation is kept current.
•	Operate milking plant and equipment in a safe manner, undertake multiple functions including reading and recording instrument information e.g. milk vat temperatures and cow numbers and matching cow ID to calves to produce a quality milk outcome.
•	Operate a dairy recycling system.
•	Calf feeding, including tubing colostrum
•	Assisting with and/or performing irrigation works.
•	Inspect livestock to gauge the effectiveness of feed formulae.
•	Transport, handle and store chemicals; prepare and apply chemicals.
•	Operate farm and dairy shed-related vehicles, plant and equipment.
•	Identify and report equipment not operating normally; maintenance of plant and machinery.
•	Where appropriately qualified, perform maintenance works on sheds, fixtures and fittings, fences and surrounds and install new or replacement equipment or fittings.
•	Transport stock, feed and equipment, if appropriately licensed.
•	Maintain records to ensure accurate information for stock and inventory control.
•	Ensure food safety regulatory requirements are met.
•	Contribute to and implement OHS requirements.
•	Computer literate – operate computer equipment and software packages requiring set-up and basic function operation.
•	Coordinate the response to emergencies for both occupational health and safety emergencies and animal welfare emergencies.
•	Participate in enterprise/industry training sessions and workshops as required.
 
Qualified applicants may apply online.

Full-Time: 		Immediate start

Job Title: 		Registered Nurse (Aged Care)
Salary range: 	$80,000 - $90,000 depending on skill level + Superannuation
Job Closure date:	30 days

About the Role:
Our Client is a community-based not-for-profit home located in a small town of Meningie. Their modern, 30 bed home has a lovely outlook over the town and Lake. Our client is looking for an experienced Aged Care Registered Nurse to join the team focussed on ensuring an excellent quality of care to residents and by extension, their families.

Key Responsibilities that will be a part of the job:

Deliver Person-Centred Nursing Care
• Provide compassionate and individualized care to elderly residents, considering their unique physical, emotional, and social needs.
• Adapt care approaches to support residents with diverse health conditions, including dementia, mobility limitations, and age-related illnesses.

Administer Clinical Care and Medical Support
• Perform essential clinical tasks such as medication administration, wound dressing, and chronic disease management (e.g., diabetes, hypertension).
• Monitor residents' health status, recognize changes, and respond appropriately to ensure optimal wellbeing.

Collaborate on Care Planning and Reviews
• Work closely with residents, their families, and the multidisciplinary care team (e.g., doctors, physiotherapists, dietitians) to assess needs, develop care plans, and regularly evaluate progress.
• Ensure care strategies align with residents’ preferences and medical requirements.

Maintain Accurate and Compliant Documentation
• Record all care interventions, observations, and health updates in accordance with organizational policies and healthcare regulations.
• Ensure documentation is clear, timely, and supports continuity of care.

Guide and Mentor Care Staff
• Provide leadership, training, and support to Enrolled Nurses (ENs) and care workers to enhance their skills and ensure high-quality service delivery.
• Foster a positive and collaborative team environment.

Uphold Resident Safety, Dignity, and Comfort
• Promote a safe, respectful, and homelike atmosphere where residents feel valued and comfortable.
• Protect residents' privacy and autonomy while maintaining infection control and risk management standards.

Engage in Professional Development and Quality Improvement
• Stay informed about best practices, aged care standards, and emerging healthcare trends.
• Participate in initiatives to enhance care quality, efficiency, and resident satisfaction.

Skills & Experience that are required and will add value to your submission:
• Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent
• Current AHPRA Registered Nurse registration.
• Minimum one year nursing experience.
• NDIS Worker Screening Check (current or within five years).
• Current flu and COVID-19 vaccinations.
• Strong teamwork, leadership and communication skills.
• Own reliable transport.
• Commitment to high-quality, person-centred aged care.

Apply Now
If you’re passionate about nursing and are ready to make a real difference, we’d love to hear from you!

Please note: All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality. We are acting as the exclusive recruitment partner for this role and our client's identity will be disclosed to shortlisted candidates.

Position Title: Retail Manager
Location: Kilkenny, South Australia
Employment Type: Full-time (38 hours per week)
Salary: $80,000 per annum + superannuation


About the Company

HHHLJ PTY LTD (as the trustee of Le Huynh Family Trust ABN 48 539 316 778 ) trading as Arndale Bakery is a South Australian family-owned bakery and wholesale supplier based in Kilkenny, providing a wide range of freshly baked products to restaurants, caterers, cafés and the local community. The business is committed to delivering consistent quality, reliable service and products that meet the needs of both commercial customers and local consumers.


Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Retail Manager to oversee the day-to- day operations of Arndale Bakery’s retail outlet. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the retail team, maintaining high standards of customer service, managing stock and product presentation, supporting sales growth, and ensuring efficient store operations. This role is suited to a hands-on leader who can create a positive team environment and deliver an excellent experience for customers.


Key Responsibilities

- Plan, organise and manage the day-to-day operations of the bakery’s retail outlet.
- Determine the appropriate product range, stock levels, pricing and customer service standards.
- Monitor sales performance, operating costs and financial results to support business growth and profitability.
- Prepare and manage store budgets, sales targets and operational expenditure.
- Develop and implement purchasing, promotional and marketing strategies.
- Manage inventory, place orders and maintain accurate records of stock movements and financial transactions.
- Build and maintain effective relationships with suppliers, commercial customers and service providers.
- Recruit, train, roster, supervise and evaluate retail employees.
- Provide leadership and guidance to staff while maintaining a positive and productive workplace.
- Ensure customers receive professional service and appropriate advice regarding bakery products and orders.
- Manage customer feedback, complaints and service issues in a timely and professional manner.
- Maintain high standards of product presentation, store cleanliness and merchandising.
- Ensure the retail outlet complies with food safety, workplace health and safety and other applicable operational requirements.
- Review store procedures and implement improvements to increase efficiency, sales and customer satisfaction.
- Coordinate with the bakery production team to ensure product availability, quality and timely fulfilment of customer orders.


Requirements

- Diploma-level qualification in retail management, business, hospitality or a related field, or at least three years of relevant management experience.
- Proven experience managing a retail store, bakery, café or similar business.
- Strong leadership skills, including staff supervision, rostering and training.
- Experience managing sales, budgets, stock, purchasing and supplier relationships.
- Excellent customer service, communication and problem-solving skills.
- Knowledge of food safety, workplace health and safety and retail operations.


How to Apply

Please submit your resume to resumes@wearefulcrum.com and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience.
